capability_statement: Operators can review provider-backed decision evidence from one read-only Mission Control console before any external write path is considered.
before_state: Provider decision replay, freshness, tool governance, and runtime safety were separate Mission Control surfaces.
after_state: Mission Control exposes provider_backed_operator_decision_console with proposed action, operator question, Go/No-Go recommendation, evidence refs, approval boundary, rollback boundary, and no-autonomous-write boundary.
scenario: Before approving a provider-backed path, the operator opens Mission Control and reviews one console to decide accept, defer, reopen, or block.
five_minute_demo: Run visibility-export and inspect provider_backed_operator_decision_console in .aof/artifacts/visibility/current/mission-control.json.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes first-pass manual joining of separate provider decision, freshness, safety, and tool governance artifacts.
cognitive_load_removed: Operators no longer need to reconstruct the provider-backed Go/No-Go path from several JSON sections.

capability_matrix.before: Separate replay, freshness, safety, and tool governance surfaces.
capability_matrix.user_value: A provider-backed decision can be reviewed without opening raw runtime JSON or granting write authority.

not_proven: Self-hosting product value evidence does not prove broad adoption, provider truth, semantic truth, credential safety, billing safety, market value, or production execution safety.
